name: UMLS Terminology Services
tagline: NIH UMLS REST API for medical concepts, CUIs, and crosswalks
description: The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) Terminology Services REST API provides programmatic access to UMLS Metathesaurus data including concepts, CUIs, atoms, relations, and source vocabulary crosswalks. Developers authenticate with a UTS API key obtained after free UMLS license approval.

auth.details: API key obtained after free UMLS license approval; typically passed as ticket parameter or Authorization header depending on endpoint version

pricing.free_tier_limits: 20 requests per second per IP address; NLM recommends caching results for 12–24 hours.

rate_limits: 20 requests per second per IP address. Excess requests may not be serviced until the request rate falls below the limit.
use_cases: look up a medical concept by CUI
search UMLS Metathesaurus for a term
retrieve concept definitions and semantic types
get related concepts and hierarchical relations
